q.en: Change into indirect speech: He said, "I am tired."
q.as: পৰোক্ষ উক্তিলৈ সলনি কৰা: He said, "I am tired."

options.en: He said that he is tired.
options.as: He said that he is tired.

options.en: He said that he was tired.
options.as: He said that he was tired.

options.en: He says that he was tired.
options.as: He says that he was tired.

options.en: He said that I was tired.
options.as: He said that I was tired.

explanation.en: The reporting verb is in the past, so the present tense 'am' changes to 'was' and 'I' becomes 'he'.
explanation.as: ৰিপৰ্টিং ক্ৰিয়া অতীতত থকা বাবে বৰ্তমান কাল 'am' ৰ পৰিৱৰ্তে 'was' হয় আৰু 'I' ৰ পৰিৱৰ্তে 'he' হয়।
